---
title: "Hypothesis 1 - Mother-daughter associations"
metadata-files:
  - _quarto.yml
---

# Overview

This script addresses **Hypothesis 1**: do mother–daughter pairs show stronger associations than other pair types during the daughter's first summer ?
and ** Hypothesis 2**, how do associations change when colony size is different, does each pair react differently?

Three pair types are compared throughout:

- mother-daughter (MD)

- mother paired with an unrelated juvenile female

- juveniles together

- all remaining female dyads ("other")

The analysis has two stages:

1.  **QAP** (year-specific): tests whether MD dyads are more strongly associated expected by chance, within each year separately.
2.  **GLMM** (cross-year): estimates the overall effect of pair type (4 types) on association strength across all eleven years, and tests whether this effect is modulated by colony size.

Both colonies (GB2 and UA) are analysed in parallel using identical pipelines.Update: final model for H1 was a merged model with two colonies together

# 2  QAP analysis (year-specific)
Tests whether MD pairs are more strongly associated than all other dyads within
each year. This is a binary comparison (MD vs. non-MD)
## 2.1 functions
```{r}
#----- build M predictor matrix for QAP 
# create matrix with 1 for mother-daughter dyads, 0 otherwise.
build_m_matrix <- function(association_matrix, edges, the_year) {

  ids <- rownames(association_matrix)
  #edges for this year + the desired pair_type
  edges_subset <- subset(edges, year == the_year & pair_type == "mother-daughter")
  
  #M matrix of zeros with same row/col
  M <- matrix(0, nrow = length(ids), ncol = length(ids),
              dimnames = list(ids, ids))
  
  #M matrix with 1 for mother–daughter
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(edges_subset))) {
    bat_i <- edges_subset$from[r]
    bat_j <- edges_subset$to[r]
    #only if both bats
    if (bat_i %in% ids && bat_j %in% ids) {
      M[bat_i, bat_j] <- 1
      M[bat_j, bat_i] <- 1
    }
  }
  
  return(M)
}

#-----  run QAP for all years 
# separately for each year - 10 000 permutations
run_qap <- function(net_list,edges){
  results_list <- list()
  
  #for each year
  for (the_year in names(net_list)) {
    A_yr <- net_list[[the_year]]
  
    #build predictor matrix
    M <- build_m_matrix(A_yr, edges, the_year) 
    g <- list(A_yr, M)
    
    #run QAP
    qap_res <- qaptest(g,FUN = gcor,g1  = 1,g2  = 2,reps = 10000)
    
    #extract statistics
    s <- summary(qap_res)
    test_val <- s$testval
    p_greq   <- s$pgreq
    p_leeq   <- s$pleeq
    
  #create result table 
    results_df <- data.frame(
      year        = the_year,
      correlation = test_val,
      pval_upper  = p_greq,
      pval_lower  = p_leeq,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    results_list[[the_year]] <- results_df
  }
  
  all_results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  rownames(all_results_df) <- NULL
  
  return(all_results_df)
}
#----- create list of all the networks for each years

net_list_GB2 <- list(
  "2013" = net_G2013,"2014" = net_G2014,"2015" = net_G2015,"2016" = net_G2016,"2017" = net_G2017,"2018" = net_G2018,"2019" = net_G2019,"2020" = net_G2020,"2021" = net_G2021,"2022" = net_G2022,"2023" = net_G2023
)

net_list_UA <- list(

)
```

## 2.1  Visualisation — association strength by year

Stars indicate QAP significance: * p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001.

```{r qap-plot}
add_sig_stars <- function(qap_df) {
  qap_df %>%
    mutate(star = case_when(
      pval_upper < 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval_upper < 0.01  ~ "**",
      pval_upper < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    ))
}

make_qap_plot <- function(edges, qap_df, colony_label) {
  edges_plot <- edges %>%
    mutate(year = as.character(year),
           pair_type = factor(pair_type,
                              levels = c("other", "mother-daughter")))
  stars <- add_sig_stars(qap_df) %>%
    mutate(year = as.character(year))

  ggplot(edges_plot, aes(x = year, y = weight, fill = pair_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.colour = "#c4c2c2") +
    geom_text(data = stars, aes(x = year, y = 0.97, label = star),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("mother-daughter" = "#402c3a",
                                 "other"           = "#c4c2c2")) +
    labs(title = colony_label, x = NULL,
         y = "Association strength (SRI)", fill = "pair type") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

p_qap_GB2 <- make_qap_plot(edges_GB2, QAP_GB2, "Colony GB2")
p_qap_UA  <- make_qap_plot(edges_UA,  QAP_UA,  "Colony UA")

combined_qap <- (p_qap_GB2 / p_qap_UA) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined_qap

ggsave(here("results", "figures", "H1_QAP_combined.png"),
       plot = combined_qap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# 3  GLMM — cross-year analysis

## 3.1 Functions
```{r}
#node-label permutation p-values (two-tailed)----- 
compute_perm_pvalues <- function(obs_coef, perm_matrix) {
  sapply(names(obs_coef), function(nm)
    mean(abs(perm_matrix[, nm]) >= abs(obs_coef[nm]))
  )
}

#permutation table (observed vs permuted distribution)----- 
make_perm_table <- function(obs_coef, perm_matrix, p_values) {
  obs_df <- data.frame(term = names(obs_coef),
                       observed = as.numeric(obs_coef),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  perm_summary <- as.data.frame(perm_matrix) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "term", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(term) %>%
    summarise(perm_mean = mean(value), perm_sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop")
  obs_df %>%
    left_join(perm_summary, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(p_value = p_values[term]) %>%
    arrange(desc(observed))
}
```


## 3.3  check for influential years (cook's distance)

Use of lme4 here in order to measure cook's distance (not possible with glmmTMB)

```{r cooks distance}
# GB2 -----
model_diag_GB2 <- lmer(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data = edges_GB2
)
infl_GB2 <- influence(model_diag_GB2, group = "year")
plot(infl_GB2, which = "cook")
cooks.distance(infl_GB2)

# UA -----
model_diag_UA <- lmer(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data = edges_UA
)
infl_UA <- influence(model_diag_UA, group = "year")
plot(infl_UA, which = "cook")
cooks.distance(infl_UA)
```

```{r}
#check random effects
VarCorr(model_diag_GB2)
VarCorr(model_diag_UA)

#correlation
cor.test(edges_GB2$year,  edges_GB2$colony_size)
cor.test(edges_UA$year,  edges_UA$colony_size)
```
/!\ Colony size and year are highly correlated

## 3.4 Weight transformation before GLMM 
Beta distribution requires values strictly between 0 and 1. Transformation following: y' = (y*(n-1) + 0.5) / n  (Smithson & Verkuilen, 2006)
```{r transformation}
#GB2
n <- nrow(edges_GB2)
edges_GB2$weight <- (edges_GB2$weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

#UA
n <- nrow(edges_UA)
edges_UA$weight <- ((edges_UA)$weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
```

```{r}
edges_GB2 <- edges_GB2 %>%
  mutate(pair_type_2 = factor(pair_type_2,
                              levels = c("other", "daughter-daughter",
                                         "mother-unrelated-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))

edges_UA <- edges_UA %>%
  mutate(pair_type_2 = factor(pair_type_2,
                              levels = c("other", "daughter-daughter",
                                         "mother-unrelated-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))
```


## 3.5 models
Two models per colony: one without interaction (main effects only) and one with
a pair type × colony size interaction to test whether the effect of pair type depends on demographic context

```{r models}
# GB2 -------
model_GB2 <- glmmTMB(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_GB2,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_GB2_int <- glmmTMB(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_GB2,
  family = beta_family()
)

# UA ------
model_UA <- glmmTMB(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_UA,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_UA_int <- glmmTMB(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_UA,
  family = beta_family()
)
```

```{r model summaries}
summary(model_GB2);     summary(model_GB2_int)
summary(model_UA);      summary(model_UA_int)
```

## 3.5 merged model (H1)
Update: for H1, merged model, two colonies together with colony ID as fixed factor
```{r}
edges_GB2$colony_ID <- "GB2"
edges_UA$colony_ID <- "UA"

#merged the two datasets
edges_full <- rbind(edges_GB2,edges_UA)

#recenter colony_size for both 
edges_full <- edges_full %>%
  mutate(colony_size_c = as.numeric(
    scale(colony_size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  ))

#recompoute the weight 
n <- nrow(edges_full)
edges_full <- edges_full %>%
  mutate(weight_beta = (weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n)

#check corr again
cor.test(edges_full$year,  edges_full$colony_size) #0.7547435 
```


```{r}
model_full <- glmmTMB(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | year) + (1 | pairID),
  data   = edges_full,
  family = beta_family()
)

summary(model_full)
```

## 3.7 diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
check_model <- function(model, label) {
  cat("\n──", label, "──\n")
  print(check_overdispersion(model))
  print(check_collinearity(model))
  sim <- simulateResiduals(model, n = 1000)
  plot(sim, main = label)
}

check_model(model_GB2,     "GB2 — main effects")
check_model(model_GB2_int, "GB2 — interaction")
check_model(model_UA,      "UA  — main effects")
check_model(model_UA_int,  "UA  — interaction")

check_model(model_full,  "Merged model")
```

# 4  Permutation (node-label permutations)

For each permutation, pair-type labels are shuffled within year while preserving the number of pairs per type The GLMM is refitted on each permutations, and the coefficients are stored. P values are measured as the proportion of permuted coefficients that are equal or exceeding the observed coefficient

We did n = 1000 permutations for each model

## 4.1  GB2

```{r perm GB2}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
set.seed(23)
n_perm <- 500

#coefficients 
coef_names_GB2 <- c(
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter",
  "colony_size_c"
)

coef_names_GB2_int <- c(
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter",
  "colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter:colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile:colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter:colony_size_c"
)

obs_coef_GB2     <- fixef(model_GB2)$cond[coef_names_GB2]
obs_coef_GB2_int <- fixef(model_GB2_int)$cond[coef_names_GB2_int]

perm_GB2     <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names_GB2),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names_GB2))
perm_GB2_int <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names_GB2_int),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names_GB2_int))

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  d <- edges_GB2 %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(pair_type_2 = sample(pair_type_2)) %>%
    ungroup()

  m <- glmmTMB(weight ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
               family = beta_family(), data = d)
  perm_GB2[i, ] <- fixef(m)$cond[coef_names_GB2]

  m_int <- glmmTMB(weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
                   family = beta_family(), data = d)
  perm_GB2_int[i, ] <- fixef(m_int)$cond[coef_names_GB2_int]
}

save(perm_GB2, perm_GB2_int,file = here("results", "H1_permutations_GB2.RData"))
```

```{r perm-gb2-pvalues}
p_GB2     <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_coef_GB2,     perm_GB2)
p_GB2_int <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_coef_GB2_int, perm_GB2_int)

table_GB2     <- make_perm_table(obs_coef_GB2,     perm_GB2,     p_GB2)
table_GB2_int <- make_perm_table(obs_coef_GB2_int, perm_GB2_int, p_GB2_int)

cat("── GB2 main effects ──\n");  print(table_GB2)
cat("\n── GB2 interaction ──\n"); print(table_GB2_int)

write.csv(table_GB2,
          here("results", "tables", "H1_perm_GB2_main.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_GB2_int,
          here("results", "tables", "H1_perm_GB2_interaction.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

#### pair comparison - inference
```{r}
get_emmeans_contrasts <- function(model) {

  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ pair_type_2)

  as.data.frame(
    pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Remove parentheses added by emmeans
      contrast_clean = gsub("\\(|\\)", "", contrast),

      # Extract the two original pair types
      level1 = trimws(sub(" - .*", "", contrast_clean)),
      level2 = trimws(sub(".* - ", "", contrast_clean)),

      # Rename them EXACTLY as they appear in the plot
      level1 = recode(
        level1,
        "mother-daughter" = "mother-daughter",
        "mother-unrelated-juvenile" = "mother-unrelated juvenile",
        "daughter-daughter" = "juvenile-juvenile",
        "other" = "other"
      ),

      level2 = recode(
        level2,
        "mother-daughter" = "mother-daughter",
        "mother-unrelated-juvenile" = "mother-unrelated juvenile",
        "daughter-daughter" = "juvenile-juvenile",
        "other" = "other"
      ),

      # Tukey-adjusted p-value
      p_value = p.value
    ) %>%

    # Don't plot comparisons involving the reference "other"
    filter(
      level1 != "other",
      level2 != "other"
    ) %>%

    select(level1, level2, p_value)
}


contrasts_GB2 <- get_emmeans_contrasts(model_GB2)
contrasts_UA <- get_emmeans_contrasts(model_UA)
```

#### pair comparison - inference
```{r}
#coeff
obs_coef_UA <- as.numeric(fixef(model_UA)$cond[coef_names_UA])
names(obs_coef_UA) <- coef_names_UA

# load saved permutations
load(here("results", "H1_permutations_UA.RData"))

# function, compute permutation p-value for a difference between two coefficients
perm_contrast <- function(perm_matrix, obs_coef, term1, term2) {

  obs_diff <- obs_coef[term1] - obs_coef[term2]
  perm_diff <- perm_matrix[, term1] - perm_matrix[, term2]

  p_value <- mean(abs(perm_diff) >= abs(obs_diff))

  data.frame(
    contrast = paste(term1, "vs", term2),
    observed_diff = obs_diff,
    perm_mean = mean(perm_diff),
    perm_sd = sd(perm_diff),
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

# define the pairwise contrasts you want
# MD vs JJ, MD vs MUJ, JJ vs MUJ
contrasts_UA <- bind_rows(
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2mother-daughter", "pair_type_2daughter-daughter"),
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2mother-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"),
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2daughter-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile")
)

contrasts_UA

# for the plot: 
contrasts_UA_plot <- data.frame(
  level1 = c("mother-daughter", "mother-daughter", "juvenile-juvenile"),
  level2 = c("juvenile-juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile"),
  p_value = c(
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2daughter-daughter"],
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"],
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2daughter-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"]
  )
)
```

# 5  Visualization — model predictions

# 5.1 - H1 association strength 

```{r}
pair_colors <- c("mother-daughter" = "#cf67b3",
                  "mother-unrelated juvenile" = "#3d4f91",
                  "juvenile-juvenile" = "#7c9fd9",
                  "unrelated females" = "#999999")

# network plot, original simple version, circles only
plot_network_year <- function(edge_df, target_year,colony_name) {

  df_year <- edge_df %>% filter(year == target_year)

  df_year$pair_type_2 <- factor(df_year$pair_type_2,
                               levels = c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                                          "daughter-daughter", "mother-daughter"),
                               labels = c("unrelated females", "mother-unrelated juvenile",
                                          "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter"))

  g <- graph_from_data_frame(df_year, directed = FALSE)
  E(g)$weight <- df_year$weight

  set.seed(23)
  layout <- layout_with_fr(g, weights = E(g)$weight)

  nodes <- data.frame(name = V(g)$name, x = layout[, 1], y = layout[, 2])

  el <- as_edgelist(g) %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename(from = V1, to = V2)
  edges_full <- el %>%
  mutate(pair_type_2 = df_year$pair_type_2,
         weight = df_year$weight) %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% rename(from = name, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "from") %>%
  left_join(nodes %>% rename(to   = name, x2 = x, y2 = y), by = "to")

  e_other <- edges_full %>% filter(pair_type_2 == "unrelated females")
  e_murd  <- edges_full %>% filter(pair_type_2 == "mother-unrelated juvenile")
  e_juv   <- edges_full %>% filter(pair_type_2 == "juvenile-juvenile")
  e_md    <- edges_full %>% filter(pair_type_2 == "mother-daughter")

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = e_other, aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2, linewidth = weight*2),
               colour = pair_colors["unrelated females"], alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_segment(data = e_murd,  aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2, linewidth = weight*2),
               colour = pair_colors["mother-unrelated juvenile"], alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_segment(data = e_juv,   aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2, linewidth = weight*2),
               colour = pair_colors["juvenile-juvenile"], alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(data = e_md,    aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2, linewidth = weight*2),
               colour = pair_colors["mother-daughter"], alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.2, 3), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = colony_name) +
  geom_point(data = nodes, aes(x = x, y = y), size = 1.3, colour = "#4f4f4f") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, face = "plain",
                                 margin = margin(b = 5)))
}

# coefficient forest plot, vs "other" reference
sig_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ ""
  )
}

plot_coef_panel <- function(model, perm_results, contrasts_df) {

  tidy_model <- tidy(model, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)

  coef_df <- tidy_model %>%
    filter(grepl("pair_type_2", term)) %>%
    left_join(perm_results %>% select(term, p_value), by = "term") %>%
    mutate(pair_label = gsub("pair_type_2", "", term),
           pair_label = recode(pair_label,
                                "mother-daughter" = "mother-daughter",
                                "mother-unrelated-juvenile" = "mother-unrelated juvenile",
                                "daughter-daughter" = "juvenile-juvenile"),
           sig = sig_stars(p_value))

  coef_df$pair_label <- factor(coef_df$pair_label,
                                levels = c("mother-unrelated juvenile",
                                           "juvenile-juvenile",
                                           "mother-daughter"))

  y_pos <- c("mother-unrelated juvenile" = 1,
              "juvenile-juvenile" = 2,
              "mother-daughter" = 3)

  bracket_x_start <- max(coef_df$conf.high) + 0.08

  # stagger brackets by span so they don't overlap
  # span 1 = adjacent levels, span 2 = skip one level
  brackets <- contrasts_df %>%
  mutate(y1 = y_pos[level1],
         y2 = y_pos[level2],
         sig = sig_stars(p_value),
         span = abs(y_pos[level1] - y_pos[level2]),
         ymid = (y_pos[level1] + y_pos[level2]) / 2) %>%
    filter(sig != "") %>%
    arrange(span) %>%
    mutate(x = bracket_x_start + (row_number() - 1) * 0.12)

  ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = pair_label, color = pair_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), size = 0.9, linewidth = 1.1) +
    # bracket vertical lines
    geom_segment(data = brackets,
                 aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y1, yend = y2),
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # bracket ticks
    geom_segment(data = brackets,
                 aes(x = x - 0.02, xend = x, y = y1, yend = y1),
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets,
                 aes(x = x - 0.02, xend = x, y = y2, yend = y2),
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # stars at midpoint
    geom_text(data = brackets,
              aes(x = x + 0.02, y = ymid, label = sig),
              color = "black", size = 4, hjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_colors) +
    labs(x = "coefficient (vs other pairs)", y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Networks
net_GB2 <- plot_network_year(edges_GB2, 2023, "Colony GB2")
net_UA  <- plot_network_year(edges_UA,  2023, "Colony UA")

coef_merged <- plot_coef_panel(model_full, table_merged, contrasts_merged_plot)

# Left column: networks stacked vertically
networks <- net_GB2 / net_UA +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

right <- plot_spacer() /
  coef_merged /
  plot_spacer() +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2, 1))

combined <- networks | right

combined <- combined +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))

combined

ggsave(here("results","figures","H1_network+coef.png"), combined, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```

# 5.2 - H2 demographic context
Using ggpredict
```{r model-predictions}

pair_colours <- c("mother-daughter" = "#cf67b3",
                  "mother-unrelated-juvenile" = "#3d4f91",
                  "juvenile-juvenile" = "#7c9fd9",
                  "other" = "#999999")

# GB2: centered range = 24-mean to 68-mean
# UA: centered range = 22-mean to 31-mean
mean_cs_GB2 <- mean(edge_GB2_clean$colony_size, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_cs_UA  <- mean(edge_UA_clean$colony_size,  na.rm = TRUE)

pred_GB2 <- ggpredict(model_GB2_int,
                       terms = c(paste0("colony_size_c [",
                                         round(24 - mean_cs_GB2), ":",
                                         round(68 - mean_cs_GB2), " by=1]"),
                                  "pair_type_2"),
                       bias_correction = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(colony_size_c = x, SRI = predicted, pair_type_2 = group,
         lower = conf.low, upper = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(colony_size = colony_size_c + mean_cs_GB2)

pred_UA <- ggpredict(model_UA,
                      terms = c(paste0("colony_size_c [",
                                        round(22 - mean_cs_UA), ":",
                                        round(31 - mean_cs_UA), " by=0.5]"),
                                 "pair_type_2"),
                      bias_correction = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(colony_size_c = x, SRI = predicted, pair_type_2 = group,
         lower = conf.low, upper = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(colony_size = colony_size_c + mean_cs_UA)

level_order   <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                    "daughter-daughter", "mother-daughter")
display_labels <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                     "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")

pred_GB2$pair_type_2 <- factor(pred_GB2$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)
pred_UA$pair_type_2  <- factor(pred_UA$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)


# plot function
make_h2_plot <- function(pred, title, show_y = TRUE) {
  ggplot(pred, aes(x = colony_size, y = SRI,
                      color = pair_type_2, fill = pair_type_2)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_colours, name = "pair type") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = pair_colours, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "colony size",
         y = if (show_y) "association strength (SRI)" else NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "plain"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
}

p_GB2 <- make_h2_plot(pred_GB2, "Colony GB2", show_y = TRUE)
p_UA  <- make_h2_plot(pred_UA,  "Colony UA",  show_y = FALSE)

combined <- p_GB2 + p_UA +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined
ggsave(here("results","figures","h2_predictions.png"), combined, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
         lower = conf.low, upper = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(colony_size = colony_size_c + mean_cs_UA)

level_order   <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                    "daughter-daughter", "mother-daughter")
display_labels <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                     "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")

pred_GB2$pair_type_2 <- factor(pred_GB2$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)
pred_UA$pair_type_2  <- factor(pred_UA$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)

yrange <- range(c(pred_GB2$lower, pred_GB2$upper,
                  pred_UA$lower, pred_UA$upper), na.rm = TRUE)

make_h2_plot <- function(pred, title, show_y = TRUE) {
  ggplot(pred, aes(x = colony_size, y = SRI,
                      color = pair_type_2, fill = pair_type_2)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pair_colours, name = "pair type") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = pair_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = yrange) +
    labs(title = title,
         x = "colony size",
         y = if (show_y) "association strength (SRI)" else NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, face = "plain"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
}

p_GB2 <- make_h2_plot(pred_GB2, "Colony GB2", show_y = TRUE)
p_UA  <- make_h2_plot(pred_UA,  "Colony UA",  show_y = FALSE)

combined <- p_GB2 + p_UA +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined
ggsave("h2_predictions.png", combined, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

# 6  other descriptive statistics
```{r stats}
# mean + SD of SRI per pair type per year, and colony size per year
summarise_edges <- function(edges, colony_label) {
  cat("\nSRI summary by year and pair type —", colony_label, "--\n")
  edges %>%
    group_by(year, pair_type_2) %>%
    summarise(mean_sri = round(mean(weight), 3),
              sd_sri   = round(sd(weight),   3),
              n_dyads  = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()

  cat("\nColony size per year —", colony_label, "--\n")
  edges %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(colony_size = mean(colony_size, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()

  cat("\nNumber of MD pairs per year —", colony_label, "--\n")
  edges %>%
    filter(pair_type_2 == "mother-daughter") %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(n_md = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    print()
}

summarise_edges(edge_GB2_clean, "GB2")
summarise_edges(edge_UA_clean,  "UA")
```


```{r}
# count dyads per pair type per year, both colonies
count_pairs <- function(edge_df, colony_name) {
  edge_df %>%
    group_by(year, pair_type_2) %>%
    summarise(n_dyads = n_distinct(pairID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(colony = colony_name)
}

counts_GB2 <- count_pairs(edge_GB2_clean, "GB2")
counts_UA  <- count_pairs(edge_UA_clean,  "UA")

counts_all <- bind_rows(counts_GB2, counts_UA)

# wide format, one row per year/colony, one col per pair type
counts_wide <- counts_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pair_type_2, values_from = n_dyads, values_fill = 0)

# add colony size per year
colony_size_GB2 <- edge_GB2_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(colony_size = length(unique(c(from, to))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(colony = "GB2")

colony_size_UA <- edge_UA_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(colony_size = length(unique(c(from, to))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(colony = "UA")

colony_sizes <- bind_rows(colony_size_GB2, colony_size_UA)

# join colony size in
summary_table <- counts_wide %>%
  left_join(colony_sizes, by = c("year", "colony")) %>%
  select(colony, year, colony_size, everything())

print(summary_table)

write.csv(summary_table, here("results","tables","summary_table_pairs.csv"))
```

```{r density}
# mean network density across years
mean_density <- function(net_list, label) {
  d <- sapply(net_list, function(net) {
    g <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net, mode = "undirected",
                                             weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
    igraph::edge_density(g, loops = FALSE)
  })
  cat("mean network density —", label, ":", round(mean(d), 4), "\n")
}

mean_density(net_list_GB2, "GB2")
mean_density(net_list_UA,  "UA")
```
